rationale: C13 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both orders delegate a defined presidential authority to a named agency or officer, condition its exercise on consultation or concurrence by other agencies, provide a mechanism for referring interagency disagreement upward, authorize rules and procedures using nearly identical language, and supersede or revoke an earlier directive. C05 and C10 share the child’s delegation formula and preservation-of-prior-actions machinery, but their overall operative structures are less closely aligned.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Federal Power Commission is hereby designated and empowered to perform the following described functions
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby delegate to the Secretary of the Interior the authority vested in the President
shared_material.explanation: Both begin by transferring a specifically defined presidential authority to a designated administrative actor.

shared_material.child_excerpt: after obtaining the favorable recommendations of the Secretary of State and the Secretary of Defense
shared_material.parent_excerpt: without the prior approval or concurrence...of the head of the department or agency concerned
shared_material.explanation: Both condition the delegated actor’s action on approval, concurrence, or favorable recommendations from other affected executive officials.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In any case wherein the Federal Power Commission, the Secretary of State, and the Secretary of Defense cannot agree...the Commission shall submit to the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Any disagreement between two or more executive departments or agencies...shall be referred to the Director of the Bureau of the Budget...The Director may...submit the matter to the President
shared_material.explanation: Both establish an escalation mechanism for unresolved interagency disagreement, ultimately allowing presidential determination.

shared_material.child_excerpt: authorized to issue such rules and regulations, and to prescribe such procedures, as it may from time to time deem necessary or desirable for the exercise of the authority delegated to it by this order
shared_material.parent_excerpt: authorized to issue such rules and regulations, and to prescribe such procedures, as he may from time to time deem necessary or desirable for the exercise of the authority delegated to him by this order
shared_material.explanation: This is nearly verbatim, distinctive shared language governing implementation of the delegated authority.
Each concludes by displacing the earlier directive governing the same delegated authority.
